note: Jobs the AI characters can offer (M12). giver: whose job it is, one card id or a list (Oda's when absent; issue #188: the smuggling run and the contract are Oda's, the fence's, Skrugs's and T-89's). Only real jobs: each one completes when something actually happens in the game (completes_on is a WorldState trigger). requires uses the same conditions as rumors. requires.story = the story chapter reached (Story.reached). standing: what the job done does to standing ({faction: n, line: the gossip}; WorldState.job_standing): Oda's jobs and every run for a fence raise the locals'. The heist and the supply run raise it their own way (heist.json paid_standing, territory.json standing.supplied).

jobs.objective: Bring the general a floating droid
jobs.title: A floating droid for the general
jobs.text: Bring me a floating droid, fixed up or bought from the droid merchant. A little one, for the barracks. I pay three times what the merchant does. Hand it over to me at the barracks.
jobs.note: Job order: the general's first job (giver: only his brain offers it, or [E] Ask for work). One floating droid handed over on his [E] menu pays 'pay_mult' times the droid merchant's resale (general.json droid_jobs), raises Remnant standing a lot and sets flag general_float_done, which closes this job for good and opens his second (j_general_repossess). Not while Remnant standing is hostile.

jobs.title: Droids for the general
jobs.text: Bring me assassin droids from the desert, fixed up or bought. I pay three times what the droid merchant does, a head. Hand them over to me at the barracks.
jobs.note: Issues #203, #204: the general's repeating job (giver: only his brain offers it). Not while Remnant standing is hostile (-40 and below, where his troopers shoot on sight). Each droid handed over pays and raises standing, and the job is open again (GeneralPost.hand_over). 'words': what he says when he offers this job; an offer whose line talks about another job's words is put right (NpcBrain), so the card always matches what he said. Job order: the general's third job, open once you have handed him your first repossessed contraband (flag general_contraband_done, j_general_repossess); the first assassin droid opens his fourth (flag general_droid_done, j_general_nuisance). Then it repeats as before.

jobs.title: Supplies for the locals
jobs.text: The locals holding %s are running out of water and charge packs. Take them a load before the Remnant come back for it; they pay %d credits.
jobs.note: Issue #187: on the board while an outpost the locals hold is short (Territory.supply_target). Taking it is carrying the supplies; walking up to that outpost hands them over, pays and fills the locals' hold back up (Territory.deliver). Taken once, the card leaves the board for good: from then on the F11 map shows which outposts are short, and any of them takes supplies when you get there (Territory.supplier).

jobs.objective: Take your ship up to the orbital patrol
jobs.title: Thin the orbital patrol
jobs.text: The locals pool 1000 credits for anyone who breaks the Remnant patrol in orbit. Your ship is in the pit; the pad is the button.

standing.line: Someone took the locals' purse for breaking the patrol in orbit.

jobs.objective: Hand a cargo droid to a droid merchant
jobs.title: A cargo droid for Oda's friend
jobs.text: Oda's friend, a droid merchant, needs a cargo droid. Buy one or fix one up in the desert, then hand it over at any droid merchant's post out there: the arrow points to the nearest. The merchant pays 200 cr for your trouble.

standing.line: Someone got Oda's friend the droid merchant a cargo droid.

jobs.note: Issue #212: the droid merchant chapter's job card, so it is queued and in the job log. Delivering the droid (Story.on_droid_delivered) finishes it, taken or not.

jobs.title: The range bet
jobs.text: Knock all five practice targets flat in under twenty seconds. The pot is 40 credits and some pride.

jobs.objective: Race the yard crew at Dorrin's
jobs.title: Race the desert crew
jobs.text: There's a crew racing out by Dorrin's yard, round the rocks. Tune that speeder up and go show them. Win once and you've done it.
jobs.note: Issue #611: Skrugs's lead to the speeder races. Optional, never needed by the story. Points at Dorrin's yard; done on your first race win (WorldState.on_race_won). Pays nothing itself: the race pays.

standing.line: Someone ran a drop for the fence.

jobs.title: A drop for the fence
jobs.text: Somebody left %s %s. Get it to the fence in the market, and keep it away from the Remnant at the front gate.

goods.say_one: a crate of space whale teeth

jobs.note: Repeats forever: Oda lines up the next drop once the last one is picked up and the player carries no contraband. Pays is what the fence gives for the goods; the fence pays it, not Oda. Issue #64: opens with the story's first smuggling run (Story chapter smuggle_1). Issue #251: 'areas': only the drops out of town (the desert past either gate); the ones inside the town are the general's (j_general_repossess). 'first_area': where its drops go until one has been sold to the fence (WorldState._roll_smuggle): the first is always out the front gate.

jobs.title: Repossess the contraband
jobs.text: Smugglers have stashed %s %s. Repossess that contraband and bring it to me at the barracks. I pay better than any fence, and the garrison will put it to better use.

goods.say_one: a crate of space whale teeth

jobs.note: Issue #251: the general's repeating smuggling job (giver: only his brain offers it, in talk, with offer_job). The same goods as the fence's run, but only from the stashes inside the town ('areas': the alleys and the roofs), and in his words: repossessing contraband for the garrison. 'deliver_to': the goods go to him, not the fence: his [E] menu takes the contraband off you for 'pay_mult' times what the fence would pay (WorldState.hand_over_contraband) and raises Remnant standing. One drop is out at a time, his or Oda's. Never moves the story on. Not while Remnant standing is hostile. Job order: the general's second job, open once you have handed him your floating droid (flag general_float_done, j_general_float), in a story save without waiting for the story's first smuggling run; the first contraband handed over opens his third (flag general_contraband_done, j_general_droids). Then it repeats.

jobs.title: A local nuisance
jobs.text: There is a local who stands in the street outside my barracks all day, shouting at my troopers. Green, head to toe: you cannot miss him. Buy a sniper rifle at the gear trader, get up on the barracks roof or a gate tower, and remove the nuisance. Quietly.
jobs.note: Job order: the general's fourth job, open once you have handed him your first assassin droid (flag general_droid_done). Taking it stands the nuisance in the street (general.json 'nuisance': a local in all green, soldier profile town_nuisance, at a marker plus an offset); killing him finishes the job on the spot: the general pays 'pay', Remnant standing goes up a lot and flag general_nuisance_done closes it for good. The locals see a local shot like any other (Townsfolk): a quiet shot from high up keeps them calm. Not while Remnant standing is hostile.

standing.line: Someone ran a drop for the moon's fence.

jobs.title: A drop for the moon's fence
jobs.text: Somebody left %s %s. Get it to the fence at his stall by my bar. No air out on the rock: armour on.

goods.say_one: a crate of space whale teeth

jobs.note: Repeats forever on the asteroid moon: the drop lands on the rock outside the sealed station (pickups/grit_station_town.json), and the fence at his stall in the club buys it. No story requirement; it belongs to grit_station_town only, and only her cantina owner offers it (no giver: Oda's, and each planet's Oda gives what Oda gives).

standing.line: Someone ran a drop for the lava moon's fence.

jobs.title: A drop for the lava moon's fence
jobs.text: Somebody left %s %s. Get it to the fence at his stall by my bar. No air out there, and keep off the lava.

goods.say_one: a crate of space whale teeth

jobs.note: The lava moon's run, as the asteroid's (j_station_smuggle_run): drops on the rock round the station, inside the ring the lava keeps clear of (pickups/cinder_station_town.json), bought by the fence at his stall in the club (lava_station_fence.json).

standing.line: Someone brought a drop down to the favela's fence.

jobs.title: Down from the Remnant's levels
jobs.text: Somebody left %s %s. Bring it down to the fence in the favela, and keep it away from the Remnant.

goods.say_one: a crate of space whale teeth

jobs.note: The space station's run (the ringed giant's town): the drop lies in a room on the Remnant's levels, their deck in the second tower or the barracks and bridge on the top floor (pickups/ringed_giant_town.json, rooms by StationHull.drop_rooms), and the fence's booth in the favela on the lower homes floor buys it (station_favela_fence.json). Offered by the station's cantina owner on the top floor.

jobs.title: A job on a Remnant control room
jobs.text: The Remnant keep a stash of refined quantonium in the control room at %s. Take %s and a droid, breach the vault with your welder, and bring the flasks to the fence. About %d cr after the crew's cut.
jobs.note: Issue #310: the locals' heist (src/systems/flow/heist.gd). Offered by the four who offer the drop and the bounty, on an outpost the Remnant hold (never while the locals hold them all). Taking it sends a local crew member and a white assassin droid with you; the console's stash (15 flasks, content/core/story/heist.json) goes to the fence, less the crew's cut. One heist at a time, either side's; a new one once the last is paid, for ever. The text is filled in: the outpost, the crew member, the pay. Issue #413: a story save reaches it at the heist chapter (Oda's job card there); free roam's 'free' chapter has it from the start. The story's first heist goes to the broken ridge outpost (remnant_outpost_mid), never the first bounty's.

jobs.title: Take back what the locals stole
jobs.text: The locals squat in our outpost at %s, and our stores of refined quantonium sit in its control room. Take %s and a droid, breach the vault with your welder, and bring the flasks to me. I pay better than the fence: about %d cr after your trooper's share.
jobs.note: Issue #310: the Remnant's heist, free roam only, offered by the general in talk (offer_job). It hits an outpost the locals hold (Territory), so it is not offered while they hold none, nor while Remnant standing is hostile (-40 and below), nor in a story save. A Remnant trooper and a Remnant assassin droid go with you; the general takes the flasks for 'pay_mult' times the fence's price (WorldState.hand_over_contraband's rate), less the crew's cut, and Remnant standing goes up.

standing.line: Someone was paid a bounty at the fence.

jobs.title: A price on a Remnant officer
jobs.note: Issue #64: repeats forever once the story reaches the bounty. The text is filled in from WorldState.bounty (the officer's name, their crime, the outpost, the pay); taking it puts the officer at that outpost; the fence pays when they are dead. Pays is the bounty. Local: the outpost is one of the planet's own where it is offered (WorldState.local_outposts: the port's desert, or a moon's rock), and that town's fence pays it (bounty_pays_at). Not offered where there are no outposts (the station).
